title: How a Godly Man Chooses His First Real Job (It's Not the Salary)
caption:
The salary will change. The man you become at work won't.

Ask what it builds, who leads you, what it asks you to bend, and who you're really working for.

What would you turn down if you knew it was shaping you?

#faith #work #career #godlymen #christianman #colossians3
